items.title: Establish an informative learning baseline through acquisition calibration
items.outcome: A bounded development study establishes a reliably competent own-initialized baseline and identifies where transfer breaks, or records a localized calibration failure; an admitted final comparison is run only after informative acquisition, with all development and confirmation evidence kept distinct.
acceptance: Keep EXP-0004's protocol, evidence, failed attempt and decision unchanged; H-001/H-002 remain open but dormant.

Before new checkpoint accumulation, establish a verified second copy of existing irreplaceable learned evidence and a bounded backup path with an isolated restore/replay check; record the destination, scope, retention and unresolved limitations.

Persist fitting telemetry before downstream verification and represent fitting, verification and resource outcomes separately; retain interrupted attempts without upgrading success. Label parameter snapshots accurately; exact optimizer resume is not required unless the protocol calls for it.

Register a development pilot with task/data identities, permitted conditions, numeric stage and per-seed/per-format acquisition gates, total search/compute/storage ceilings, all-attempt logging and stop rules before fitting.

Progress from tiny-set fitting through fresh one-format generalization and mixed-format acquisition to development transformation tests; measure training/validation accuracy, loss curves and per-format support.

Include a credible learned baseline and a bounded diagnostic of information loss, such as a raw-input bypass or less restrictive intermediate; charge altered capacity and access. Disclosed auxiliary prediction or paired-view supervision is permitted with equivalent control access.

Retire prior inspected final data, isolate new development and confirmation partitions at the latent problem/trajectory level, and verify actual input overlap. Freeze confirmation settings, seeds and criteria before final evaluation; do not tune on final scores.

Record acquisition and transfer separately with failures, selection history and total costs; a competent baseline can support later research without a conditional-transport win. Complete relevant local checks, artifact recovery evidence and hosted delivery verification.
verification: Review primary methods and commit the bounded pilot contract and executable implementation before development fitting; this plan entry is not an executable protocol.
Demonstrate preservation of fitting evidence under an injected post-fit verification failure and verify any required restore from the second copy.
Validate task semantics and information boundaries independently; retain development curves and all attempts, then replay the selected frozen comparison if its acquisition gates admit one.
Run relevant Rust checks and refresh/replay EXP-0001 if affected source changes; follow exact delivered-commit CI.
items.stop_condition: Stop at the registered development or confirmation limits and record the scoped outcome; no unbounded search, runtime rewrite, N-008/N-009 execution, deeper ShardLoom integration or learned halting is implied.

items.title: Test learned problem representation across surface transformations
items.outcome: One from-scratch comparison of input-dependent problem structuring against fixed-layout and learned-static controls, with equal learning opportunities, common resource ceilings, held-out surface transformations, independent replay, and a scoped research decision.
acceptance: Keep H-001/H-002 open but dormant; do not add another memory selector, allocation gate, or infrastructure-polish queue.
Promote H-011 only for a bounded, source-grounded operational test; describe the supplied representation choices and the difference from an unrestricted representation-discovery claim.
Expose raw numeric fields, never latent order, surface identity, canonicalization, cross-surface pairs, or labels to inference.
Compare a fixed-layout solver, a larger fixed-layout solver, learned input-dependent transport with a fixed-capacity solver, and learned static transport under a frozen shared learning budget.
Hold out surface/rotation combinations and reflection compositions, keep validation separate, retain all five training seeds, and charge representation construction and conversion.

Verify exact task semantics independently, tensor/native agreement, intermediate-state restart, counterfactual transport dependence, and fresh replay before recording a retain/reject/inconclusive decision.
Complete local checks and hosted verification, with checkpoints retained locally.
verification: Commit design, strict protocol and implementation before any fitting or quality inspection.
Run only the admitted development preflight, then the registered campaign without tuning or replacement seeds.
Refresh and replay EXP-0001 after source changes; follow exact delivered-commit CI.
items.stop_condition: Close this one experiment at its registered decision and delivery checks. Reusable computation, deeper ShardLoom integration, and other horizon questions require a separate queue decision; do not start them to remain busy.

items.title: Build the Rust foundation with replaceable physical execution
items.outcome: A restartable Rust execution path over persistent native state with selective payload reads, shared parameterized transformations, dynamically extended work graphs, replaceable physical providers, and explicit resource/evidence contracts; a bounded ShardLoom evidence-analytics interoperability probe.
acceptance: The core is independent of an LLM/Transformer, and scripted fixtures remain distinct from learned capability.
An end-to-end slice changes selected persistent state, reopens it, and reproduces the expected result without activating inactive payloads; commit validation I/O is accounted separately.
Revision/hash/transaction checks and resource failures preserve persistent state integrity.
Dynamic work reuses operator parameters and reports actual execution and payload-access evidence.
An independent provider exercises the same executor and unsupported operations fail explicitly.
A bounded actual-engine ShardLoom probe records exact query results, route evidence, unsupported outcomes, and evidence limitations without a cognitive-state dependency.
Representation horizon questions and Apache-2.0 artifact boundaries reflect the owner's course corrections.
Local Rust/Python checks and hosted Linux/macOS checks pass with bounded unsynced build storage.
verification: Run and replay EXP-0001 after Python source identity changes.
Run scripts/shardloom_probe.py with an explicitly identified existing binary; inspect raw envelopes and exact outputs.
Follow hosted Linux/macOS checks for the delivered commit.
items.stop_condition: Close the executable foundation slice with evidence, then continue to N-002; do not mistake infrastructure success for learned intelligence.

items.title: Complete autonomous foundation delivery and hosted verification
items.outcome: The foundation is published to the existing public Noetloom repository, hosted checks are green, and future routine delivery follows the user's standing authority without repeated push questions.
acceptance: Project instructions consistently record the standing Noetloom commit/push/CI grant.
The delivery skill passes syntax and independent behavioral review.
Relevant local checks pass and the complete foundation is pushed to origin/main.
Hosted Linux Python 3.11 and macOS Python 3.13 checks, including harness replay, pass for the delivered commit.
verification: Validate the delivery skill and review its behavior against the user's autonomy request.
Inspect the Checks workflow for the pushed commit and repair any in-scope failures.
items.stop_condition: Close after publication and hosted verification; do not start a new learning experiment as part of an authority/docs correction.

items.title: Establish the autonomous research foundation
items.outcome: A small portable repo with discoverable instructions, research provenance, one active queue, validated experiment contracts, storage admission, and reproducible harness controls.
acceptance: All local tests and repository checks pass.
EXP-0001 passes and its evidence is replay-verified.
The project skill is validated and available locally.
An adversarial review has no unresolved blocking findings.
items.stop_condition: Close after the foundation and harness evidence are verified; record the next experiment as a separate research decision.

items.title: Test a learned sparse state-cell core against matched controls
items.outcome: A reproducible from-scratch learned candidate and credible matched baseline, with explicit data access, frozen splits, multiple seeds, costs, retention/interference results, and a retain/revise/reject decision.
acceptance: Read relevant paper methods, not only abstracts, and freeze a learning protocol before evaluation.
Choose the smallest informative scale after a bounded backend and throughput preflight.
Control information access, training/tuning compute and inference budgets; include memory and routing ablations.
Hold out task structures or compositions as well as random seeds; measure generalization and confidence intervals.
Archive learned artifacts before retiring unique local outputs; record negative results.
verification: EXP-0002 protocol committed before preflight/fitting; all 20 runs independently replayed.
Follow hosted checks for the experiment delivery commit.
items.stop_condition: Stop at the registered experiment budget or a defensible research decision; do not scale or add mechanisms to rescue a failed result without amending the protocol.

items.title: Evaluate learned allocation of additional state reads
items.outcome: A controlled test of compute allocation or learned reusable structure chosen from the preceding experiment's measured limitation.
acceptance: Freeze the two-stage read-allocation mechanism from EXP-0002's measured limitation before implementation.
Charge inherited training, gate acquisition, selection, verification and all payload/descriptor work.
Test fresh key pools, a new operation interleaving, stale-event interference and capacity shifts; procedural reuse and its invalidation remain untested.
Compare fixed sparse/dense endpoints and an equal-payload input-independent allocator with paired-seed uncertainty.
Record a scoped retain/reject decision and complete hosted verification without claiming general intelligence.
verification: Design registered in 6b46d34 and strict source/protocol committed in bd7c1b0 before preflight/fitting.
All five seed runs independently replayed: 15,360 native predictions and 40 persistence/restart queries.
84 Python tests, 36 Rust tests, formatting, Clippy, contracts and refreshed harness replay pass.
items.stop_condition: Stop at registered retain/drop criteria or a prerequisite that needs a new design decision.
